neighbours.label: The opening 'ur' of rare, foreign or coined words that the tokenizer splits into pieces: German Ur- words (Urteil, Urheberrecht, Ursprung), names such as Urdu, Urquhart, Urhobo and the city of Ur, and the Python module urllib. Common English ur- words that are single tokens (urban, urge, urgent, URL) and look-alikes (your, pure, Uber) stay quiet.
fire: The ursine creature lumbered through the snow.
Der Ursprung des Flusses liegt in den Alpen.
Das Gericht verkündete gestern das Urteil im langen Prozess.
Das Urheberrecht schützt Werke bis siebzig Jahre nach dem Tod des Autors.
Niemand kennt den genauen Ursprung dieser alten Legende.
She grew up speaking Urdu at home and English at school.
The ruins of Urquhart Castle overlook the dark waters of Loch Ness.
Many Urhobo families live in the Delta region of Nigeria.
quiet: The court announced its decision yesterday in the long trial.
Copyright protects works until seventy years after the author's death.
Urban planners redesigned the downtown area last spring.
She felt a strong urge to call her sister.
The ruins of the old castle overlook the dark waters of the lake.
This is an urgent message for your manager.
Please paste the URL into your browser's address bar.
Your package will arrive by Friday afternoon.
